definitions.explanation: Having a pleasantly warm temperature, typically referring to climate.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}{中|じゅう}→一年中：17104_ichinenjuu⟧{温暖|おんだん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This region is warm all year round.

examples.japanese: {温暖|おんだん}な⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごしやすい→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: The warm climate makes it easy to live here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧{温暖|おんだん}⟦{化|か}→化：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。

notes:
{温暖|おんだん} describes warm climate or temperature, especially for regions.

FORMS:
- {温暖|おんだん}な + noun (warm ~)
- {温暖|おんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (warmly)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {温暖|おんだん}な⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧ (warm climate)
- {温暖|おんだん}な⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ (warm region)

IMPORTANT COMPOUND:
- ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧{温暖|おんだん}⟦{化|か}→化：noentry⟧ (global warming)
- {温暖|おんだん}⟦{化|か}→化：noentry⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (measures against warming)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧: warm (general, casual)
- {温暖|おんだん}: warm climate (more technical/formal)
- ⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧: mild, gentle (personality/weather)
